description: This file declares the TensorListGetItemSPMDExpander class, which inherits from SPMDExpanderBase, and appears to be part of the MLIR tensor expansion mechanisms within TensorFlow's DTensor subsystem. It declares methods for expanding operations and computing layouts for tensor list get-item operations in a distributed context.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: TensorListGetItemSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class that provides methods to expand MLIR tensor list get-item operations and compute their tensor layouts for distributed execution in TensorFlow.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given MLIR operation for distributed tensor processing.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the tensor layout of the operation's inputs based on the operation and its outputs.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the tensor layout for the operation's outputs based on the operation and its inputs.
